text:
jamie: hi folks, jamie here (first week). following the runtime quickstart on ubuntu VM but hit a link error referencing libcublasLt when building. using CUDA 12.2 from toolkit tarball.
jamie: link error:
```
undefined reference to `cublasLtCreate'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```
sean: welcome! :wave: libcublasLt is part of newer cublas packages. run `ls /usr/local/cuda-*/targets/x86_64-linux/lib | grep cublasLt` and `ldd build/runtime | grep cublas` to confirm.
priyanka: if you installed toolkit via tarball, sometimes the lib name differs (libcublasLt.so vs libcublasLt.so.12). Ensure the symlinks exist or install cuBLAS package matching your driver. Also avoid mixing CUDA 12.2 against CI baseline 12.1.
jamie: `ldd` shows libcublasLt.so => not found. I tried symlinking libcublasLt.so.12 -> libcublasLt.so but still hit a cudart mismatch at runtime.
sean: symlinks can mask ABI mismatches. Prefer installing the distro/deb or our internal docker dev image. If you're on M1, don't try to emulate locally for GPU builds.
jamie: I'm on an x86 VM but started from an M1 laptop using ssh. Curious: do we have a pre-provisioned dev VM with matching stack?
infra-bot: infra-bot: request a gpu-dev-onboard VM in #eng-infra with `username`, preferred CUDA (12.1), and note "onboarding runtime". We have a pre-baked image with CUDA12.1+cudnn8 and pinned gcc-11.
priyanka: one more tip: add `-DCMAKE_BUILD_RPATH=/usr/local/cuda-12.1/lib64` or set LD_LIBRARY_PATH during run. And run `git submodule update --init --recursive` before cmake.
jamie: switching to infra image (CUDA12.1) now. thanks for the pointers, will report back if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
